about.title: About het Tolhek
about.subtitle: Over 20 years of craftsmanship
about.intro: Het Tolhek manufactures furniture and all kinds of other objects from wood and sheet material, fully tailored to the client's wishes.
about.description: Whether it's a kitchen, a table, a new counter, a built-in closet, or something very specific — het Tolhek is your destination. Every project is executed with care and attention to detail.
about.owner: Het Tolhek is a sole proprietorship of Heije Hilvers since 2003. Since 2022, the workshop has been located in Bakkeveen.

method.title: Our Method
method.subtitle: From idea to reality
method.intro: All work is made to order. For custom work, an appointment is made to review the situation and discuss wishes and possibilities.
method.step1_desc: We schedule an appointment to review the situation and discuss your wishes and possibilities.
method.step2_desc: Based on this, a 3D drawing is made so you get a clear picture of the final result.
method.step3_desc: If the design meets your expectations, a completely non-binding quote is prepared.
method.step4_desc: After approval, we get to work. The final result is delivered with craftsmanship and attention to detail.
